question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.**
solution:
The correct answer is: "**Structure**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• "**Structure**" refers to the arrangement or organization of something. (संरचना)

 
 
• **For example**: *The Eiffel Tower is an iconic example of an architectural structure.*
 
 
 
• It can also refer to something that has been built or constructed, such as a building or bridge.
 
• In the given context, "structure" is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "**Contracture**" refers to the permanent shortening or tightening of muscles, often due to injury or disease. (अवकुंचन)
 
• "**Conjecture**" refers to a guess or speculation based on incomplete information. (अनुमान)
 
• "**Sculpture**" refers to the art of creating three-dimensional works of art, often by carving or moulding materials such as stone or clay. (मूर्तिकला)
